title: Quotes, Order Bump, Add Items and Disputes in Your Store | CrestApps for Orchard Core
description:
Not every order is an ordinary checkout. CrestApps takes quote requests and answers them with your own prices, adds items to a paid order, offers an order bump and a recovery email to buyers who leave, exports orders to CSV, and shows disputes and risky payments on the order.

In this video:
• Why more than an ordinary order
• Settings: quote requests, the recovery email and the order bump
• A buyer asks for a quote, and you price and send it
• The buyer accepts by paying
• Adding items to a paid order, and exporting orders
• What a dispute and a risky payment look like
